header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: and recites the Du'a (بِسْمِ اللهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَي اللهِ لَاحَوْلَ وَلَاقُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ) (I go out saying the name of Allah Ta'ala. I have placed my trust in Allah alone; turning away from evil and gaining the strength to do good are possible only by the command of Allah, an angel says to him, “Your task has been accomplished, and you have been protected from every harm”. Shaytan is defeated and moves far away from him, Hazrat Anas ibn Malik (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.text:
In another narration it is mentioned: At that time (after he recites this Du'a) it is said to him, “You have received complete guidance, your task has been accomplished. You have been protected'. So the shayateen move far away from him, and another shaytan says to the first shaytan, “How can you gain control over one who has received guidance and whose task has been accomplished?'
(Abu Dawud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْكَرْبِ: لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ رَبُّ السَّموَاتِ وَرَبُّ اْلاَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب الدعاء عَنْد الكرب رقم:٦٣٤٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates, “At times of distress the Prophet ﷺ would recite: (لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ ) رَبُّ السَّموَاتِ وَرَبُّ اْلاَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِThere is none worthy of worship besides Allah Ta'ala; He is the Most Great, the Most Forbearing (He does not punish immediately because of the sins of His servants).
